Subject: Request: Ephemeral sprint fuel for POC blast

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our side — we’re about to run a concentrated 36-hour throughput validation against the Redwood endpoint for the Cart-Aggregator POC (aiming for sustained 500 RPS with 256-token avg). The engineering team plans an overnight soak beginning 2026-05-24 22:00 PDT.

We’ve used the trial credits so far and will need a short-term boost to avoid throttling during the soak window. Can Redwood provide an ephemeral voucher (approx. 150k token equivalent) or temporary top-up scoped only to the BRIGHT-2026-34 POC?

Attached is our load plan and a short timeline — poc_load_plan.xlsx (high level). Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want more detail.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of Platform | BrightCart
Samantha Liu <samantha@brightcart.com>

Attachment: poc_load_plan.xlsx (xlsx, 92 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Ephemeral sprint fuel for POC blast

Hi Samantha — thanks for the plan and heads-up. This is the sort of short, focused soak we usually accommodate. A couple quick questions before I route to approvals:

- Can you confirm the expected sequence length distribution and % of long-form responses vs short tokens? That affects token accounting for the voucher.
- Is the traffic going to come from a single region (us-west) or multiple regions?

Karthik — looping you in for a quick throughput estimate from the serving side and any queueing/latency caveats (we’ve seen p95 bumps during 500+ sustained bursts).

Naomi — can you flag what floor-level promotion budget we have for a one-off trial top-up for this type of mid-market POC? If we can approve a voucher, we’ll scope it to BRIGHT-2026-34 and attach a short usage expiry (48h after start).

Samantha — if you can reply inline with the two bullets, I’ll expedite this.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha@brightcart.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Ephemeral sprint fuel for POC blast

Ben / Samantha — I took a quick look at the attached load plan. High level notes:

- Sequence length: ~80% at 64-128 tokens, 20% at 512 tokens (translates to ~1.4x token estimate vs naive avg).
- Region: single region (us-west) — good for latency consistency but increases p95 risk under saturation.
- Recommendation: allocate 180k token-equivalent voucher to be safe for a 36h burst with a cushion. We can also enable transient KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts which should trim token consumption by ~10-15% mid-soak.

I attached a quick sample telemetry CSV from a similar run (throughput-summary.csv) to show token burn patterns and where p95 creeps up. If we approve 180k tokens scoped to BRIGHT-2026-34 with a 72-hour expiry from issuance, the ops team can throttle by route if needed.

If that works, I’m fine with me approving the engineering caveats and letting Naomi sign the promo.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SW/Infra | Redwood Inference
Attachment: throughput-summary.csv (csv, 12 KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Hi all — approved.

Finance sign-off: temporary promotional voucher for BrightCart, deal BRIGHT-2026-34. Details below:
- Voucher value: 180,000 token-equivalent
- Scope: Redeemable only by BrightCart project BRIGHT-2026-34 (Customer ID redwood-ext-8392)
- Validity: Issued on 2026-05-23 09:00 PDT; expires 2026-05-26 09:00 PDT (72 hours)
- Constraints: Usage capped by route / project; any overage will be billed per standard trial rates.

Samantha — I’ll attach the approval stub and voucher code in a follow-up secure PDF. Ben — please confirm the issuance window and that the redemption flow and route-scoping are in place before 2026-05-23 09:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
